assertions.claim: Of 736 strokes, 14.1% had neither facial droop nor arm weakness — the three FAST signs alone would have missed them.
assertions.cn_span: 736 例卒中里有 14.1% 一开始既不歪嘴也不瘫手

assertions.claim: Adding unsteadiness/double vision/missing field cut reduces missed strokes to 4.4% (Kentucky stroke center 2014 review).
Nose-finger ataxia and closed-eye instability are cerebellar signs, but no maneuver reversely excludes stroke.
assertions.cn_span: 指鼻不准、闭眼站不住是小脑受累的体征，但没有哪一个动作能反过来排除卒中

assertions.claim: Posterior-circulation infarcts are most often mistaken for cervical spondylosis, hypoglycemia, or BPPV, losing time.
assertions.cn_span: 最容易被当成颈椎病、低血糖、耳石症耽误

assertions.claim: The study is a single-center retrospective analysis; the authors themselves note prospective validation is needed.
assertions.cn_span: 该研究是单中心回顾性分析，作者自己写明需要前瞻验证
